result_text:
I fixed the typos in the default conventions in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`. I didn't add new tests for the `.htm`, `.js`, `.xml` and `build-gradle.js` cases. The existing scoping and convention tests pass, but I haven't confirmed they exercise these particular rules.

- **Generated HTML (pkgdown, Doxygen, meta generator):** the extension group was `(html|html|xhtml)`; it is now `(html|htm|xhtml)`, so `.htm` pages match too.
- **`// Generated by …` JavaScript:** the filename pattern was `.*/[.]js`, which only matched a file literally named `.js`. It is now `.*[.]js`.
- **.NET `<doc>` XML:** the filename pattern was `.*/[.]xml`. It is now `.*[.]xml`.
- **Gradle JavaScript scripts:** the pattern was `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js`, which needed a literal `.-gradle.js`. It is now `.*[-]gradle[.]js`, so `build-gradle.js` matches.

Only the filename parts were edited, so everything that matched before still does. Hand-written `.htm`, `.js` and `.xml` files stay out of these scopes because the content patterns are unchanged.

I didn't commit.
